caption: The video captures two adjacent concrete surfaces that fill the scene. A pale gray pebbled slab sits on the left and a smoother reddish-pink slab on the right, divided by a roughly vertical seam. A long dark shadow of a person lies diagonally across both slabs. Its rounded head and shoulder rest on the gray side while the legs extend toward the upper right on the red side. A thin, straight pole-like shadow crosses the upper portion of the scene. This narrow line gradually tilts and drops lower, eventually crossing the seam and overlapping the torso shadow. The vertical seam and the person's silhouette drift leftward, suggesting a slow camera translation across the ground. The person's shadow outline shifts subtly, with a small arm or hand-like protrusion appearing near the torso later. The shadow motion and leftward drift continue without resolving into a clear start or finish.
